result.apnNormalizeCheck:
Verified. The 51% strict baseline matches the claim exactly. But normalization only lifts it to 63.8% — well short of the 90%+ promise. The unfixable counties reveal why: Duval/Hillsborough are storing the literal string "Property Appraiser" in the apn column (a scraper extraction bug, not an APN format mismatch), and Brevard's RealAuction case IDs ("2949237") aren't APNs at all.

result.scrapeBreakdownNumbers:
I have the data. Note one important caveat in the sample: the first row's `apn` is the literal string "Property Appraiser" — the scraper extracted a label, not the parcel number. So the strict-join 91 likely includes some noise and the real lead surface is somewhat smaller than the raw count suggests. But 182 SCHEDULED-recent across 16 counties is the actual day-1 surface.
